translation.title: Terbinafine Hydrochloride Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes - tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea cruris (jock itch) and tinea corporis (ringworm of the body) - and for pityriasis versicolor caused by Pityrosporum orbiculare.
translation.usage: Before use, wash the affected area clean and dry it completely, then apply enough of the solution 1 to 2 times a day so that the affected area and its surroundings are thoroughly wetted. For infections in skin folds (under the breasts, between the fingers or toes, between the buttocks, in the groin), the area may be covered with gauze, especially at night. The treatment period is once a day for 1 week for tinea pedis (athlete's foot), tinea cruris (jock itch) and tinea corporis, and twice a day for 1 week for pityriasis versicolor. Symptoms usually start to ease within 2 to 3 days; to prevent the infection from coming back, treat regularly with this medicine for the appropriate period.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for children. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have skin lesions that may be irritated by alcohol. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it in the eyes (on the cornea or conjunctiva); if it gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on the face, nails, scalp, around the mouth or on the vaginal area. Use it with caution on cracked or eroded (raw) skin. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. If your symptoms do not improve after the treatment period, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Adverse reactions may occur - excessive irritation, hypersensitivity reactions, eye irritation, commonly skin peeling, itching, skin lesions, skin disorders and hives, rarely dry skin, contact dermatitis, eczema and rash, and uncommonly pain, pain or irritation at the application site; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature, keep out of reach of children, and do not freeze.
